What's new

Every Finlume release on Google Play, newest first.

Version 1.1.31 · 15 October 2026

  • The company profile shows the range of analyst forecasts.
  • The dividends screen also opens for non-US portfolios with payments in the broker statement.
  • The XTB import saves sales of delisted companies and payouts for fractional shares after a reverse split.
  • The results chart handles reverse splits; you can also add a split by hand in the position menu.
  • Portfolio and home show your currency at once, not dollars first.
  • Notifications and the widget always use the app language.

Version 1.1.30 · 13 October 2026

  • New: realized gains — the result of every sale and the total per year in Portfolio results.
  • New: the XTB import also reads sales and dividends with withholding tax; the dividends screen shows what you received and the tax due in your country.
  • The dividend forecast accounts for a stock split after the company's latest report.
  • The criteria assistant names criteria the way the app does, in every language.
  • Prices from exchanges outside the US refresh every morning.

Version 1.1.29 · 12 October 2026

  • New: stock splits and reverse splits in your portfolio. The app detects them and recalculates the share count — shown in the position history, a banner and a notification.
  • Purchases before a split: choose whether the share count is from before the split or after it.
  • The criteria assistant answers faster when Google's model is overloaded.
  • Fix: the profile of an ETF or non-US share could close the app.

Version 1.1.28 · 11 October 2026

  • New: criteria assistant in the screener. Ask by text or voice — it explains terms and turns a description of companies into criteria (your own Google AI Studio key).
  • New strategies: Profitable growth and Tech giants.
  • New criterion: net income growth without a break.
  • The selected sector is now shown, and strategies are sorted alphabetically.
  • The app says why data is missing — the widget too, when prices are waiting to be fetched.
  • Minor fixes.

Version 1.1.27 · 10 October 2026

  • New: ETFs and shares from exchanges worldwide in your portfolio — by search or XTB import; new provider EODHD.
  • New: a profile for ETFs and non-US shares — price in the trading currency, chart, price alert, watchlist.
  • New: Settings → Data providers — what each key enables and what is left today.
  • Free price targets from FMP; the ranking takes up to 100 companies at once.
  • My portfolio and Portfolio results show the same value for today.

7 October 2026

  • Note: Alpha Vantage has removed price targets from its free plan. The price target and the upside ranking now work only with a paid plan from that provider; the earnings calendar stays free.
  • New: portfolio dividend forecast — per year and as a percentage of cost, per company and broker.
  • New: a notification when an insider buys shares of a company you hold or watch.
  • Minor fixes.

6 October 2026

  • New: Import data from XTB. Load the account history file from xStation and your purchases of US-listed companies land in the portfolio with date and amount. Importing again adds only new purchases.
  • Dialogs and the text typed in them survive rotating the phone.
  • Removing a data provider key now asks for confirmation.
  • Messages are visible again after rotating the screen.
  • Minor fixes.

Versions 1.1.17–1.1.20 · October 2026

  • Purchase history: each position is a list of transactions with date, amount and broker; buys and sells settled FIFO.
  • Each purchase shows its value and result today.
  • New: Portfolio results — value and result over time, for the whole portfolio or one broker, compared with the same purchases in the S&P 500 or Nasdaq 100.
  • Results based on what you actually paid, at the purchase-day exchange rate.
  • The widget now works on Samsung phones.
  • Minor fixes.

Version 1.1.16 · 1 October 2026

  • First release on Google Play.
